think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented meaning. 2) Check whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., 0, -1) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto), rather than just ‘smaller/larger’. 3) If such sentinel values exist and are explicitly defined to change the function (not merely the magnitude), classify as a special knob and record those values.
